milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak fence U-shape is placed at spawn-relative (1-3, 0, 3-4). Target is set to the center of the fence cluster at (2,0,4). max_distance=16 is generous since the fence is visible from spawn, and facing_tolerance=60° ensures the player is intentionally looking toward the fence to demonstrate they found it.

Uses inventory_has because mining granite_wall with a pickaxe drops the granite_wall item into the player's inventory. The wooden pickaxe provided is sufficient to mine stone-type wall blocks. This is the preferred rule for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory and granite_wall is not in the starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a ladder places the ladder item into the player's inventory. The recipe requires 7 sticks in an H-pattern on a 3×3 crafting grid (requiring the crafting table behind the granite wall), producing 3 ladders. The player starts with exactly 7 sticks and no ladders, so min_count=1 reliably detects successful crafting.
